output.recommendation: To address the standards gap regarding pre-deployment validation of ML model updates and standard AI incident interfaces from the ML pipeline, a domain-level policy recommendation would be to mandate compliance with ITU-T Y.3172 for sandbox validation of network-ML updates and align with ITU-T Y.3181 for defining an interface that carries AI incident notices from the pipeline (P node / MLFO) to authorities, thereby ensuring robust testing and oversight before deployment.
output.rationale: [G1] and [G2] provide clear guidance on the necessity of sandbox validation and the architecture for pre-deployment evaluation. Implementing these standards would ensure that AI-driven operations in critical telecom networks are thoroughly tested and securely managed.
